name: n8n-calendly-smart-workload-balancer
description: Webhook-driven sales scheduling balancer for n8n and Node.js: verifies Calendly invitee webhooks and assigns each meeting by weighted round robin, factoring in PTO calendars, open-deal load, working hours, and timezone fit, then updates HubSpot ownership. DRY_RUN and SANDBOX_MODE are on by default.

scripts.verify: npm run check:workflow && npm run validate:workflow && npm test

author: DH Robin <robin@dhrobinsystems.com> (https://dhrobinsystems.com)
